title: The 'travel to a known place' list only ever offers a handful of named landmark hubs, never the dozens of ordinary rooms actually visited between them (confirmed intentional by the opening tutorial line, but easy to forget mid-game when a menu unexpectedly shrinks from '9 known places' to a short named list after grouping by region).
